entities.summary:
William Henry Hartnell was an English actor, who is best known for portraying the first incarnation of the Doctor, in the long-running British science-fiction television series Doctor Who from 1963 to 1966; he reprised the role in 1972–1973. In film, Hartnell notably appeared in Brighton Rock (1949), The Mouse That Roared (1959) and This Sporting Life (1963).

He was associated with military roles, playing Company Sergeant Major Percy Bullimore in the ITV sitcom The Army Game and Sergeant Grimshaw, the title character in the first Carry On film Carry On Sergeant (1958). historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As the first incarnation of the Doctor in the British science-fiction television series Doctor Who, William Hartnell's portrayal set the stage for a cultural phenomenon that has endured for decades, influencing popular culture and inspiring new generations of fans. His legacy extends beyond the screen, with the show continuing to educate and entertain audiences worldwide.
